name: panel-desk
title: Panel coverage
subtitle: Coverage on the displayed date. Readiness requires evidence through each term end.

sections.title: Positions to cover
sections.sql: select code,panel,position,coverage_on,required,accepted,ready,gap from v_panel_coverage order by code,position

sections.title: Next sixty days
sections.sql: select code,panel,expert,position,ends_on from v_term_readiness where status='accepted' and ends_on between current_date and current_date+60 order by ends_on

sections.title: Requires attention
sections.sql: select kind,code,panel,subject,issue,due_on from v_attention order by due_on
